question: Please find out how widespread the appeal of our top five actors is. What percentage of our customers have rented films featuring these actors?
sql:
-- Final answer: percentage of customers who rented films featuring the top 5 actors
WITH top5_actors AS (
    SELECT a.actor_id
    FROM actor a
    JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id
    JOIN inventory i ON fa.film_id = i.film_id
    JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
    GROUP BY a.actor_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT r.rental_id) DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
customers_with_top5 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT r.customer_id
    FROM top5_actors t5
    JOIN film_actor fa ON t5.actor_id = fa.actor_id
    JOIN inventory i ON fa.film_id = i.film_id
    JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
)
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT cwc.customer_id) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer), 2) AS pct_customers
FROM customers_with_top5 cwc;
